files.document_title: Pulaski Expansion Project map, Columbia Gulf Transmission, January 2026
files.what_it_shows: The proposed route as a blue line from the existing TC Energy line near Stanford in Lincoln County, south past Waynesburg and Science Hill and east of Somerset, to Burnside in Pulaski County, Kentucky.
Page 1 rendered at 150 dpi. Simplified road map with town dots and route shields, no scale bar.

searched: The oilandgaswatch record and its attached documents.
notes: The oilandgaswatch record page is a JavaScript application shell, so the URL checker cannot read it. The geometry comes from the site's data record, which was saved in fetched_layers/ogw. The oilandgaswatch geometry is graded Medium by that site.
